about: The PDF's bookmarks only cover the financial statements (p. 33 on). These entries give the narrative report (pp. 3–31) its sections. Titles are the printed headings; page is the 1-based PDF page. "at": "top" starts the section at the top of the page — p. 4 prints its heading last in the text layer. Where a page has no printed heading in the text layer, the title says what the pages are.
